prompts.head: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas for Wildbound. Create ONE transparent PNG sprite sheet, 1024 by 512 landscape, EXACTLY 4 equal columns and 2 equal rows (8 equal 256x256 cells), no gutters or grid lines. Each cell contains one detached BALD human chibi adventurer head, NO HAIR, no neck/body, no text. Consistent cute sophisticated pixel-art like classic fantasy RPG portraits: large expressive moss-green eyes with cream eye whites and small sparkling pupils, warm tan peach skin, tiny button nose, soft cheek blush, petite smiling mouth, gentle rounded chin, delicate dark brown pixel outline. Angular square pixel clusters with 4-6 shade steps, intentionally crisp pixels, around 64 actual design pixels per head, not smooth vector or painting. Unisex young adult adventurer, NO baby. Head occupies central 68% of each cell width and 72% height, exactly same scale. Cell order left to right top to bottom: row 1: front facing viewer eyes open; three-quarter view facing LEFT eyes open; LEFT profile eyes open; three-quarter rear facing LEFT (NO eyes or facial features). Row 2: full BACK of bald head (NO facial features); front facing viewer eyes CLOSED peacefully; three-quarter LEFT eyes CLOSED; LEFT profile eyes CLOSED. Keep head proportions cute like big-eyed black-haired elf pixel sprites with sculpted brows and little lips, but bare regular round human ears (elf ears will be added in-game). True transparent empty background, no shadow, no labels, no checkerboard. Absolutely uniform 4x2 cell layout with every head wholly contained in its cell and blank margins.
prompts.hairA: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production modular HAIR sprite atlas for Wildbound fantasy pixel RPG: transparent PNG, portrait aspect 2:3, exactly FOUR equal columns and SIX equal rows, 24 cells. Each row is ONE hairstyle seen from four camera angles left-to-right: straight FRONT facing viewer, three-quarter LEFT, LEFT PROFILE, straight BACK. Six rows top-to-bottom: 1 short tousled crop; 2 chin-length bob with cute parted bangs; 3 long flowing hair with side-swept bangs; 4 high ponytail with bangs and tiny gold tie; 5 narrow tall mohawk with shaved sides; 6 soft curls. Every cell only detached dark charcoal gray HAIR (like removable wig), NO HEAD, NO FACE, NO EARS, NO NECK, NO BODY, NO MANNEQUIN. Face opening must be genuinely transparent. Same cute chibi head proportions throughout. Crisp detailed square-pixel fantasy style inspired by beautiful black-haired pixel elf adventurers, dark near-black contour, carefully placed dark gray midtones and slate gray chunky strand highlights; no smooth vectors, no photoreal. Make designs at approximately 72 actual design pixels across the head; full image high resolution around 1024x1536. Uniform equal cell positions precisely centered, all wigs contained with generous blank margins, crowns all at 20% cell height, wig scalp width 64% of cell; imagined chin at 66% cell height. Long locks and ponytails extend to 90% height. Back views have solid hair across the back of head (no facial opening). All hairstyles neutral grayscale for later tinting, gold ties permitted. No labels, letters, grid, shadows, checkerboard, or scenery. True transparent background. Exactly 4 columns, exactly 6 rows.

prompts.materials: Use case: stylized-concept. Production fantasy pixel RPG MATERIAL TEXTURE ATLAS. One square image, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, edge-to-edge seamless material swatches, no text, no borders, no gutters. Each of 16 square cells completely filled by a single subtle grayscale material texture, medium gray mean brightness. Crisp tiny square pixels with restrained light and dark shading, designed to shade cute detailed chibi adventurer clothing at close zoom. Each swatch about 128 actual design pixels across, large output 1024x1024. Reading left to right top to bottom: row1 soft woven linen with sparse small folds; smooth worn leather with fine stitching along one side; neatly riveted polished steel armor with layered overlapping plate seams; supple dark cloak fabric with long vertical draped folds. Row2 tiny interlocking chainmail links; overlapping dragon scales; stitched quilted gambeson diamonds; fine wood grain. Row3 broad leaf-like overlapping organic armor plates; fine frost crystals on icy metal; subtly etched arcane runes on metal; aged bronze with tiny rivets. Row4 smooth skin shading with very subtle warmth but mostly grayscale; tightly wrapped cloth bandages; alternating slender vertical cloth pleats; brushed iron with delicate edge scratches. This is a technical sprite texture source, not display illustration. Subtle tonal texture that won't overwhelm a small character. No objects, body parts, heads, writing, icons, or perspective. Uniform square atlas cells.
